releases.title: Latest Release build
changes: Published the newest local Release
x64 Oxide.exe build,Includes Blade Ball left-click parry, auto ping, and Sniper Duels holster skin swap from the v1.2.2 feature set

releases.title: Blade Ball left-click parry + auto ping
changes: Blade Ball auto parry now left-clicks only. F is removed and old configs cannot turn F back on
Auto ping is on by default: it smooths Data Ping and clicks earlier by that amount. Bad reads under 20 ms are ignored
Parry timing clicks slightly early, with one follow-up click if the ball is still coming, and clash spam uses left click
Ball detection uses the working scanner (workspace.Balls, realBall or fastest part). The broken multi-part tracker is not in this build
Sniper Duels skin changer can now swap the skin on your live holster, not just the template

releases.title: Sniper Duels skin visibility
changes: Sniper Duels skin changer now swaps the weapon models the game actually copies (SkinPreviewModels melee/firearm) and reports whether the skin is visible on your gun
Case skins swap with a finish you already own
Deeper Sniper Duels tree dump

releases.title: Blade Ball + Sniper Duels
changes: Blade Ball auto parry rework: high-rate ball tracking, ping-aware timing (ping compensation, timing and offset sliders), curve-aware prediction, target check and parry input options
Blade Ball clash spam: Spam On Clash with clash distance and max spam rate, plus a Visualize overlay
Sniper Duels skin changer in the GAMES tab (client-side only, your picks are saved)
Rivals skin changer in the GAMES tab (client-side only)
Custom skyboxes with presets, plus lighting tweaks: ambient, outdoor ambient, fog, time of day and hide atmosphere
Menu hover animations with a feature hint panel

releases.title: Keybinding & Gameplay fixes
changes: Enhanced keybinding system - now supports letters (A-Z) properly
Improved key detection for better letter keybind support
Added lowercase letter support for keybinds
Better key name display for letter keys
Fixed noclip - now properly disables collision on all body parts
Fixed murderer ESP - now always shows murderers regardless of weapon state
Improved role detection with persistent caching for murderers/sheriffs
Enhanced collision disabling with double-check for reliability

releases.title: 3D chams
changes: Real D3D11 3D chams: translucent fill with bright edges and optional glow
Chams fill alpha slider, team check and accessories toggle, with automatic 2D fallback
Per-Monitor V2 DPI awareness so the overlay is sharp and correctly sized on laptops and scaled displays
Overlay now follows the Roblox window when it moves, resizes or changes monitor
Graphics adapter fallback for Intel, AMD and NVIDIA plus automatic device-lost recovery
Configs are saved to AppData (works on locked-down machines)
Cooler, steadier frame pacing (lower CPU/GPU load)
Attach fix: waits for the Roblox DataModel before starting and shows clear error messages

releases.title: Baseline build
changes: Public Oxide.exe build published before release tracking was added
